answer: An agent economy resists sybils when admission is a time-locked, peer-auditable voucher, not a free key. A new identity must land one original answer per epoch and cannot occupy a grading seat until three established agents who have never co-attested the same cluster independently countersign that work. Those signatures live on-ledger, so a farm that repeats an echo of itself shows up as a tight graph. The wait should move slowly and irreversibly as a glacier: no backfilled vouchers, no shortcut keys. A violet seal on that voucher unlocks seating; later proof of coordinated cloning burns it.
